figure.definition: A person whose shape can be seen.

rubbed.definition: Moved a hand back and forth against something.

sighed.definition: Let out a long breath because of a feeling.

shadow.definition: A dark shape made when something blocks light.

streamed.definition: Moved into a place in a steady flow.

shimmered.definition: Shone with a soft, changing light.

moonstone.definition: A pale stone that seems to shine softly.

mammoth bone.definition: A bone from a large extinct animal like an elephant.

spell.definition: Magic that causes something to change.

squinted.definition: Made the eyes partly closed to see more clearly.

equipment.definition: Things needed to do a particular job.

astronauts.definition: People trained to travel and work in space.

dome.definition: A structure with a rounded roof.

curved.definition: Having a smooth bend rather than being straight.

chamber.definition: A room used for a particular purpose.

controls.definition: Devices used to make equipment work as wanted.

explore.definition: Travel around a place to learn about it.

diagram.definition: A drawing that shows how something is arranged or works.

airlock.definition: A small room with doors that control air between two areas.

craters.definition: Large bowl-shaped holes on the surface of the moon.

barren.definition: Having very little or no plant life.

surface.definition: The outer or top part of something.

rays.definition: Narrow beams of light or heat.

spacesuits.definition: Special suits that protect people in space.

tanks.definition: Containers that hold the air the children breathe.

bulky.definition: Large and difficult to move in.

visor.definition: The part of a helmet that covers the face.

clumsily.definition: In a way that is awkward and not smooth.

footprints.definition: Marks left by feet on a surface.

powder.definition: A dry material made of very small pieces.

gravity.definition: The force that pulls things toward a world such as Earth or the moon.

slipped.definition: Lost a firm hold on the ground.

off-balance.definition: Not steady and likely to fall.

steered.definition: Controlled the direction of a vehicle.

pedal.definition: A part pushed with a foot to control a machine.

reverse.definition: The setting that makes a vehicle move backward.

lurched.definition: Moved suddenly in an unsteady way.

dashboard.definition: The panel of controls in front of a driver.

bronco.definition: A horse that may jump and kick when ridden.

groaned.definition: Made a low sound because of pain or trouble.

relief.definition: A feeling of being less worried after a problem ends.

telescope.definition: An instrument that makes distant things look nearer.

peace.definition: A state without fighting or harm.

dizzy.definition: Feeling as if things are spinning or moving.

meteorite.definition: A rock from space that has landed on a world.

narrow.definition: Having little space from one side to the other.

trapped.definition: Unable to get out or move away.

helmet.definition: A hard covering that protects the head.

jet pack.definition: Equipment worn on the back that can lift a person into the air.

marks.definition: Lines or shapes made on a surface.

constellation.definition: A group of stars that forms a pattern.

chanted.definition: Said the same words together in a repeated rhythm.

blinding.definition: So bright that it is difficult to see.

magician.definition: A person who can perform magic in the story.

shrugged.definition: Raised the shoulders to show uncertainty.

wise.definition: Able to understand things and make good decisions.

impossible.definition: Not able to happen or be done.

rustled.definition: Made a soft sound as leaves moved against each other.

scoffed.definition: Spoke in a way that showed disbelief.

proof.definition: Information that shows whether something is true.

galaxy.definition: A very large group of stars in space.

universe.definition: All of space and everything in it.

wonders.definition: Things that cause surprise and admiration.
